description: This file defines an interface for retrieving product images in a CMS module of a sales management system, providing method signatures for various ways to access product images.

classes.name: ProductImageGet
classes.description: An interface extending ImageGet, providing methods to access product images by various parameters.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image given merchant store code, product code, and image name.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image with specified size.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image given a ProductImage object.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a given Product.
